column1: # Hand-edited Japanese readings that win over Open JTalk's data when the tables are rebuilt
# (uv run python scripts/frontend/build_ja_lexicon.py ...). One entry per line: surface<TAB>reading.
# A one-kanji key sets that kanji's default reading; any other key is a word-table entry.
# Readings are kana spelled as pronounced (long vowels with ー: とうきょう -> トーキョー).
